title: AI Application Cost, Latency, and Provider Choices knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “AI Application Cost, Latency, and Provider Choices”?
options: Model selection is a multi-objective decision involving task quality, latency, cost, availability, data handling, and maintainability. Use a representative evaluation set and monitor total system cost rather than comparing marketing claims alone.
It guarantees correct outcomes in every context and removes the need for independent evaluation.
It is always identical to a fixed if/then script, regardless of the data or task.
It can be trusted solely because its output is fluent or its internal score is high.
questions.answer_key: Model selection is a multi-objective decision involving task quality, latency, cost, availability, data handling, and maintainability. Use a representative evaluation set and monitor total system cost rather than comparing marketing claims alone.
questions.explanation: The lesson defines the topic this way: Model selection is a multi-objective decision involving task quality, latency, cost, availability, data handling, and maintainability. Use a representative evaluation set and monitor total system cost rather than comparing marketing claims alone. The distractors claim guarantees or equivalences that are not supported by the curriculum.

questions.prompt: When applying “AI Application Cost, Latency, and Provider Choices” to a new problem, which practice is the strongest default?
options: Skip evaluation when the first demonstration looks convincing.
Define the goal and boundaries, test realistic cases, and inspect failure modes before relying on the result.
Tune all decisions directly on the final test examples until the score improves.
Assume a method that worked once will work on every population and input distribution.
questions.answer_key: Define the goal and boundaries, test realistic cases, and inspect failure modes before relying on the result.
questions.explanation: Define the goal and boundaries, test realistic cases, and inspect failure modes before relying on the result. This practice makes assumptions visible and gives a reviewer evidence beyond one convincing demonstration.

questions.prompt: Which conclusion is appropriately cautious after a system demonstrates “AI Application Cost, Latency, and Provider Choices”?
options: The system has proven its result is unbiased and safe for every use.
A successful example removes the need for monitoring or documentation.
No. Check uncertainty, context, data quality, security, and affected users; report limitations and use human oversight appropriate to the impact.
Any numeric score or generated explanation is a guarantee of factual correctness.
questions.answer_key: No. Check uncertainty, context, data quality, security, and affected users; report limitations and use human oversight appropriate to the impact.
questions.explanation: Observed performance is conditional on the test conditions. Review uncertainty, context, risks, and failures before deciding how the system may be used.
